newsitem.title: FRANCE: France delays study of business tax reform.
newsitem.headline: France delays study of business tax reform.

text.p: The French finance ministry said on Monday that it was delaying plans to set up a working group to look at overhauling local business taxes.
The group had originally been due to be formed on Tuesday.
"The establishment of a group on local business taxes...has been cancelled and delayed until a later date," the ministry said in a statement.
The statement came ahead of conservative President Jacques Chirac's expected announcement of snap parliamentary elections to give him a free hand in the lead-up to European monetary union.
The government announced earlier this month it was setting up a working group to review local business taxes and present a report before the end of the year.
Succcessive governments have promised to reform the "taxe professionelle," a tax charged by local authorities on busineses in their area, but have failed to carry out the pledge.
The working group was to have included representatives from business and local and national politicians.
